name: BEARNDAO
report: The attack exploited a bug in ConvertDustToEarned() and used a sandwich attack. Relied on the current balance of the `wantToken` token. But the strategy contract is not supposed to hold a huge amount of dust tokens. The attacker first manipulated the ALPACA/WBNB pool through large-valued swaps and invoked a call to the convertDustToEarned function, thereby artificially inflating the swap ratio of the tokens. The reverse swap allowed the attacker to perform a sandwich attack, letting them take away approximately $768,358 worth of assets as profits.
report_zh: 攻击利用了 ConvertDustToEarned() 中的 bug 并使用了三明治攻击。该函数依赖于 `wantToken` 代币的当前余额，但策略合约本不应持有大量 dust 代币。攻击者首先通过大额交换操纵 ALPACA/WBNB 池，并调用 convertDustToEarned 函数，从而人为提高代币的交换比率。逆向交换让攻击者能够进行三明治攻击，获利约 768,358 美元。
